purpose: Noncommercial Pokémon fan game asset trial
changes: Rebuild with blender --background --factory-startup --python assets/characters/run-bipeds.py -- charmander (keeps the Tripo rig, skin and idle; replaces run with a longer-striding springy jog keyed on the rig, 0 credits; moves the 221 tail-flame vertices Tripo skinned to R_Forearm wholly onto Waist), then pnpm assets:charmander. Offline meshoptimizer 1.3.0 reduces 2584 triangles to 1808 (30.03%) while preserving UV, normal and skin attributes. The bad humanoid arm channels are replaced with baked creature shoulder/elbow/wrist poses; scratch is a new 1.2-second grounded claw motion using idle body support, not the original slash lunge. shoot is removed entirely. Animation buffers and constant tracks are deduplicated. No additional paid generation.

verification.handClearance: 45 samples per clip; hand vertices tested laterally against non-arm torso triangles. No penetration samples in idle, walk, run or scratch.
verification.scope: Geometric sampling and actual Three.js preview; not a continuous collision proof or gameplay animation approval.

limitations: Generic biped skeleton still has no dedicated tail joints.
The original paid retarget history includes shoot; that clip is absent from the shipping GLB.
rights: Pokémon character IP belongs to its rights holders. Generated output and noncommercial use do not imply permission, endorsement, or an open-source license. No official game screenshots are shipped.
